title: RPG Simulator 20XX
description: Find the cheapest equipment loadout to win a boss fight, and the most expensive one that still loses.
writeup:
## Approach

This is a combinatorial optimization problem disguised as an RPG. We enumerate all valid equipment loadouts and simulate each fight to find the extremes.

## Part 1

The shop rules constrain our choices: exactly 1 weapon, 0-1 armor pieces, and 0-2 rings. This gives a manageable number of combinations (5 weapons x 6 armor options x 22 ring combos = 660 loadouts).

For each loadout we simulate the fight mathematically rather than turn-by-turn. Since damage per turn is constant, we just compute `ceil(boss_hp / player_dpt)` and `ceil(player_hp / boss_dpt)` to see who dies first. The player wins if they need fewer or equal turns. We track the minimum gold cost among all winning loadouts.

## Part 2

The twist: find the *most* gold you can spend and still *lose*. Same enumeration, but now we track the maximum cost among losing loadouts. The answer is surprisingly high because expensive defensive gear (high armor, low damage) can cost a lot while still not dealing enough damage to win.
